nExpenses.en: {n, plural, =0 {No expenses} one {# expense} other {# expenses}}
nExpenses.sk: {n, plural, =0 {Žiadne výdavky} one {# výdavok} few {# výdavky} many {# výdavku} other {# výdavkov}}

perDay.en: {amount} a day · {n, plural, one {# expense} other {# expenses}}
perDay.sk: {amount} na deň · {n, plural, one {# výdavok} few {# výdavky} many {# výdavku} other {# výdavkov}}

vsLastMonth.en: {dir, select, less {{pct}% less than this time last month} more {{pct}% more than this time last month} other {About the same as this time last month}}
vsLastMonth.sk: {dir, select, less {O {pct} % menej ako minulý mesiac k tomuto dňu} more {O {pct} % viac ako minulý mesiac k tomuto dňu} other {Približne ako minulý mesiac k tomuto dňu}}

seeAll.en: {n, plural, =0 {No expenses this month} one {See the expense} other {See all # expenses}}
seeAll.sk: {n, plural, =0 {Tento mesiac žiadne výdavky} one {Zobraziť výdavok} few {Zobraziť všetky # výdavky} many {Zobraziť všetky # výdavku} other {Zobraziť všetkých # výdavkov}}

dueBody.en: {amount} on {date}. Add it to your expenses?

addedBody.en: {amount}, as planned. Tap to check it.
addedBody.sk: {amount} podľa plánu. Klepnutím si ho pozriete.

exported.en: {n, plural, =0 {Saved an empty file.} one {Saved # expense.} other {Saved # expenses.}}
exported.sk: {n, plural, =0 {Uložil sa prázdny súbor.} one {Uložený # výdavok.} few {Uložené # výdavky.} many {Uložené # výdavku.} other {Uložených # výdavkov.}}

importDone.en: {added, plural, =0 {No expenses added} one {Added # expense} other {Added # expenses}}{created, plural, =0 {} one {, # new category} other {, # new categories}}{skipped, plural, =0 {.} one {; # row could not be read.} other {; # rows could not be read.}}
importDone.sk: {added, plural, =0 {Nepridal sa žiadny výdavok} one {Pridaný # výdavok} few {Pridané # výdavky} many {Pridané # výdavku} other {Pridaných # výdavkov}}{created, plural, =0 {} one {, # nová kategória} few {, # nové kategórie} many {, # novej kategórie} other {, # nových kategórií}}{skipped, plural, =0 {.} one {; # riadok sa nedal prečítať.} few {; # riadky sa nedali prečítať.} many {; # riadka sa nedalo prečítať.} other {; # riadkov sa nedalo prečítať.}}

moreProblems.en: {n, plural, one {…and # more row} other {…and # more rows}}
moreProblems.sk: {n, plural, one {…a ešte # riadok} few {…a ešte # riadky} many {…a ešte # riadka} other {…a ešte # riadkov}}

keepSpendingBehindFingerprint.en: Keep your spending behind your fingerprint, face or screen lock if you turn the lock on
keepSpendingBehindFingerprint.sk: Chrániť vaše výdavky odtlačkom prsta, tvárou alebo zámkou obrazovky, ak zámku zapnete

warnWhenBudgetIs.en: Warn you when a budget is nearly used up and remind you about recurring payments
warnWhenBudgetIs.sk: Upozorniť vás, keď je rozpočet takmer vyčerpaný, a pripomínať pravidelné platby

saveExpensesAsCsv.en: Save your expenses as a CSV file, or add expenses from one
saveExpensesAsCsv.sk: Uložiť výdavky ako súbor CSV alebo z neho výdavky pridať

showThisMonthSpending.en: Show this month’s spending and an Add button on your home screen
showThisMonthSpending.sk: Zobraziť na ploche tohtomesačné výdavky a tlačidlo Pridať

takePhotoReceiptKeep.en: Take a photo of a receipt to keep with the expense
takePhotoReceiptKeep.sk: Odfotiť bloček a uložiť ho k výdavku

expensesSavedAsCsv.en: Your expenses, saved as a CSV file in a place you choose
expensesSavedAsCsv.sk: Vaše výdavky sa uložia ako súbor CSV na miesto, ktoré vyberiete

amountsAreShownThis.en: Amounts are shown in this currency. Changing it does not convert amounts you already entered.
amountsAreShownThis.sk: Sumy sa zobrazujú v tejto mene. Zmena meny neprepočíta sumy, ktoré ste už zadali.

allSpendingTogetherLeave.en: For all your spending together. Leave it empty for none.
allSpendingTogetherLeave.sk: Pre všetky výdavky spolu. Ak ho nechcete, nechajte pole prázdne.

tellMeWhenRecurring.en: Tell me when a recurring expense is added
tellMeWhenRecurring.sk: Oznámiť, keď sa pridá pravidelný výdavok

onlyDaysWithNothing.en: Only on days with nothing logged yet.
onlyDaysWithNothing.sk: Len v dňoch, keď ešte nič nie je zapísané.

leaveItEmptyUse.en: Leave it empty to use the colour of the category's icon.
leaveItEmptyUse.sk: Ak pole necháte prázdne, použije sa farba ikony kategórie.

leaveItEmptyNo.en: Leave it empty for no budget.
leaveItEmptyNo.sk: Ak rozpočet nechcete, nechajte pole prázdne.

nextDateItIs.en: The next date it is added. After that, it follows the schedule.
nextDateItIs.sk: Dátum, keď sa pridá nabudúce. Potom sa pridáva podľa plánu.

addWhatSpendFew.en: Add what you spend in a few taps. Everything stays on this phone.
addWhatSpendFew.sk: Zapíšte, čo miniete, niekoľkými klepnutiami. Všetko zostane v tomto telefóne.

tryLongerPeriodLower.en: Try a longer period or a lower amount.
tryLongerPeriodLower.sk: Skúste dlhšie obdobie alebo nižšiu sumu.

addCategoriesSuchAs.en: Add categories such as Groceries or Rent, and give them a monthly budget if you like.
addCategoriesSuchAs.sk: Pridajte kategórie, napríklad Potraviny alebo Nájom, a ak chcete, nastavte im mesačný rozpočet.

addRentBillsSubscriptions.en: Add rent, bills and subscriptions once. They are added to your expenses when they are due.
addRentBillsSubscriptions.sk: Nájom, účty a predplatné pridajte raz. K výdavkom sa pridajú vždy, keď budú splatné.

chooseCurrencyIfLike.en: Choose your currency and, if you like, a monthly budget. Then add your first expense. Your data stays on this phone: no account, no ads.
chooseCurrencyIfLike.sk: Vyberte si menu a ak chcete, aj mesačný rozpočet. Potom pridajte prvý výdavok. Vaše údaje zostanú v tomto telefóne: bez prihlasovania, bez reklám.

whereItWentThis.sk: Na čo išli peniaze tento mesiac

expensesAddThisMonth.en: Expenses you add for this month show up here. The arrows above go to other months.
expensesAddThisMonth.sk: Výdavky, ktoré pridáte za tento mesiac, sa zobrazia tu. Šípkami hore prejdete na iné mesiace.

pickPeriodNarrowIt.en: Pick a period and narrow it down. To see one category, open it under Budgets.
pickPeriodNarrowIt.sk: Vyberte obdobie a zúžte výber. Jednu kategóriu si pozriete, keď ju otvoríte v časti Rozpočty.

startIsAfterEnd.en: The start is after the end.

bringHistoryWithPick.en: Bring your history with you. Pick a CSV file exported from this app, from most expense and budget apps, or from a spreadsheet.
bringHistoryWithPick.sk: Preneste si svoju históriu. Vyberte súbor CSV exportovaný z tejto aplikácie, z väčšiny aplikácií na výdavky a rozpočet alebo z tabuľkového editora.

columnsAreMatchedBy.en: Columns are matched by name, in any case: a date; an amount (or separate expense and income amounts); a category; a note, description, title or payee; a type, income or transfer column; a payment method. Amounts may use a decimal comma or point, a currency sign or brackets for spending. They are added as they are, in your app’s currency.
columnsAreMatchedBy.sk: Stĺpce sa hľadajú podľa názvu, bez ohľadu na veľké a malé písmená: dátum; suma (alebo zvlášť sumy výdavkov a príjmov); kategória; poznámka, popis, názov alebo príjemca; stĺpec s typom, príjmom alebo prevodom; spôsob platby. Sumy môžu mať desatinnú čiarku alebo bodku, znak meny alebo zátvorky pri výdavkoch. Pridajú sa tak, ako sú, v mene aplikácie.

incomeTransfersAreLeft.en: Income and transfers are left out when the file marks them with a type, income or transfer column, separate income amounts, or To and From transfer rows. A file with an account or wallet column and none of those has signed amounts: only its negative amounts are added, as spending. Other files are read as spending. Missing categories are created for you. Rows without a readable date or amount are skipped, and you see which ones and why.
incomeTransfersAreLeft.sk: Príjmy a prevody sa vynechajú, ak ich súbor označuje stĺpcom s typom, príjmom alebo prevodom, zvlášť sumami príjmov alebo riadkami prevodov „To“ a „From“. Súbor so stĺpcom účtu alebo peňaženky bez týchto stĺpcov má sumy so znamienkom: pridajú sa len záporné sumy, ako výdavky. Ostatné súbory sa čítajú ako výdavky. Chýbajúce kategórie sa vytvoria samy. Riadky bez čitateľného dátumu alebo sumy sa vynechajú a uvidíte, ktoré a prečo.

theseRowsCouldNot.en: These rows could not be read, with the reason for each:
theseRowsCouldNot.sk: Tieto riadky sa nedali prečítať, pri každom je dôvod:

thisPhoneCanT.en: This phone can’t take photos here yet.
thisPhoneCanT.sk: V tomto telefóne sa tu zatiaľ nedá fotiť.

addItNowIt.en: Add it now, it takes a few seconds.
addItNowIt.sk: Zapíšte to hneď, zaberie to pár sekúnd.

display.title: =item.name
display.subtitle: =has(item.budget) ? t('ofBudget', {'spent': formatCurrency(item.spentMonth, settings.currency), 'budget': formatCurrency(item.budget, settings.currency)}) : t('spentThisMonth', {'spent': formatCurrency(item.spentMonth, settings.currency)})

hueName.label: @colourName
hueName.compute: =upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#D32F2F' ? 'red' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#C2185B' ? 'pink' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#7B1FA2' ? 'violet' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#512DA8' ? 'indigo' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#1976D2' ? 'blue' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#0288D1' ? 'cyan' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#00897B' ? 'teal' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#388E3C' ? 'green' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#F9A825' ? 'amber' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#EF6C00' ? 'orange' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#6D4C41' ? 'brown' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#546E7A' ? 'grey' : optionHue(item.icon)

spentMonth.label: @spentThisMonth2
spentMonth.compute: =coalesce(sum(item.expenses.filter(e, e.date >= startOf(today(), 'month') && e.date <= endOf(today(), 'month')).map(e, e.amount)), decimal('0'))

budgetState.label: @budget2
budgetState.compute: =!has(item.budget) ? 'none' : item.spentMonth > coalesce(item.budget, decimal('0')) ? 'over' : item.spentMonth * 100 >= coalesce(item.budget, decimal('0')) * settings.warnAt ? 'near' : 'ok'

display.title: =item.name
display.subtitle: =item.active ? (item.dueNow ? t('dueSince', {'rule': formatRecurrence(item.schedule), 'date': formatDate(item.nextDue, 'MMMd')}) : t('nextOn', {'rule': formatRecurrence(item.schedule), 'date': formatDate(item.nextDue, 'MMMd')})) : t('paused', {'rule': formatRecurrence(item.schedule)})

filtered.where: =item.date >= args.from && item.date <= args.to && (args.payment == 'any' || item.payment == args.payment) && item.amount >= args.minAmount

spentStat.label: @spentThisMonth2
spentStat.delta: =t('vsLastMonth', {'dir': int(round(double(abs(coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0')))) * 100.0 / max(double(coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0'))), 0.01))) == 0 ? 'same' : coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) < coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0')) ? 'less' : 'more', 'pct': int(round(double(abs(coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0')))) * 100.0 / max(double(coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0'))), 0.01)))})
spentStat.deltaTone: =int(round(double(abs(coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0')))) * 100.0 / max(double(coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0'))), 0.01))) == 0 ? 'neutral' : coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) < coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0')) ? 'success' : 'warning'
spentStat.deltaIcon: =int(round(double(abs(coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0')))) * 100.0 / max(double(coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0'))), 0.01))) == 0 ? null : coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) < coalesce(q.lastMonthSoFar.total, decimal('0')) ? 'trending_down' : 'trending_up'

budgetBar.label: @monthlyBudgetUsed
budgetBar.tone: =coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) > coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) ? 'danger' : coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) * 100 >= coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) * settings.warnAt ? 'warning' : 'primary'

budgetLine.text: =coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) > coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) ? t('overBy', {'over': formatCurrency(coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) - coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')), settings.currency), 'budget': formatCurrency(coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')), settings.currency)}) : t('leftOf', {'left': formatCurrency(coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) - coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')), settings.currency), 'budget': formatCurrency(coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')), settings.currency)})

budgetName.text: =item.name + ': ' + t('ofBudget', {'spent': formatCurrency(item.spentMonth, settings.currency), 'budget': formatCurrency(coalesce(item.budget, decimal('0')), settings.currency)})

budgetCrossed.when: =settings.budgetAlerts && has(item.category.budget) && item.date >= startOf(today(), 'month') && item.date <= endOf(today(), 'month') && ((coalesce(item.category.spentMonth, decimal('0')) * 100 >= coalesce(item.category.budget, decimal('0')) * settings.warnAt && (coalesce(item.category.spentMonth, decimal('0')) - item.amount) * 100 < coalesce(item.category.budget, decimal('0')) * settings.warnAt) || (coalesce(item.category.spentMonth, decimal('0')) > coalesce(item.category.budget, decimal('0')) && coalesce(item.category.spentMonth, decimal('0')) - item.amount <= coalesce(item.category.budget, decimal('0'))))

totalCrossed.when: =settings.budgetAlerts && coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) > 0 && item.date >= startOf(today(), 'month') && item.date <= endOf(today(), 'month') && ((coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) * 100 >= coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) * settings.warnAt && (coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) - item.amount) * 100 < coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) * settings.warnAt) || (coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) > coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0')) && coalesce(q.monthTotal.total, decimal('0')) - item.amount <= coalesce(settings.monthlyBudget, decimal('0'))))
